$jsonSchema.title: Tax rule principle
$jsonSchema.description: One sales-tax principle with the worked scenarios beneath it, shown on the Sales Tax page's Texas Tax Rules tab. Drafted from Texas Comptroller and statute sources; status says whether a person has verified it.

category.description: The grouping used by the category filter.

usualTreatment.description: The usual result for the principle as a whole; each scenario states its own taxable and nontaxable conditions.

jurisdiction.description: The taxing jurisdiction, for example Texas.

items.description: A statute, rule or publication cited, for example Tax Code section 151.318.

authorities.description: Every citation used by the scenarios, de-duplicated.

label.description: Name of the statute, rule or publication.

no.description: Scenario number, unique across the collection.

inPractice.description: Practice guidance, written for any business.

authority.description: The exact citation string for this scenario.

industry.description: Food distribution marks scenarios specific to food handling.

status.description: drafted until a person has checked the citations against the source.

lastVerified.description: When a person last verified the entry; null while drafted.
